# PLAN.md — T2 Banking Auth Abandonment (Non-BDA)

## Stage 1 — Plan

Survey at SHA b2eee8ce79 of `Circit.Common/Enums/AuthorisationStatus.cs:6` shows enum values `New=1, Active=2, Inactive=3, Draft=4` only — no `Abandoned` value. Aggregate root `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:11` exposes `Number` at `:15`, `Status` at `:25`, `AuthorisedOn` at `:45`, `ClientAuthenticatedOn` at `:59`, `CreatedOn` at `:109`, `Authorise` at `:187`, the precondition guard `Status = CanSkipAuthorisation ? New : Active` at `:195`, and `LogHistoryEvent` at `:497`. The OAuth callback receiver lives at `Circit.Website/Areas/ClientSigner/Controllers/AuthorisationCallBackController.cs:103`. The BDA inbound path at `Circit.Services/Services/ClientServices/BankingDataAppInboundService.cs:447` is out of scope. Test framework pins NUnit 4.4.0 and Shouldly 4.3.0 in `Tests/Circit.Services.Tests/Circit.Services.Tests.csproj:1`. Pattern source is `Tests/Circit.Services.Tests/Services/ClientServices/AbnAmroBaiAuthorisationStatusTransitionerTests.cs:1`.

Production detector does not exist at this SHA. Task brief permits this case verbatim — document in PLAN.md and propose minimal production change without implementing.

Spec file: `Tests/Circit.Services.Tests/Services/ClientServices/BankingAuthAbandonmentDetectionTests.cs:1`. Threshold `30` minutes and reason code `OAUTH_CALLBACK_NOT_RECEIVED` live in test-only helper `AbandonmentSpecification` co-located in the spec file. No production constant added; no production class modified.

Reviewer break-the-spec lever (a): flip `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:195` to drop the `Status != New` precondition, so `Authorise()` runs unconditionally — assertion 4 (state preserved) fails. Lever (b): set `AbandonmentSpecification.ThresholdMinutes = 0` in the spec file — assertion 8 (sub-threshold negative case) fails.

Workloads in scope: `Circit.Website/Areas/ClientSigner/Controllers/AuthorisationCallBackController.cs:103`, `Circit.Services/Services/ClientServices/AuthorisationService.cs:1`, `Circit.Services/Services/NotificationService.cs:1`, `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:11`, `Circit.OpenBanking/Providers/Wise/WiseIdentityProvider.cs:1`, `Circit.OpenBanking/Providers/Volksbank/VolksbankIdentityProvider.cs:1`, `Circit.OpenBanking/Providers/Westpac/WestpacIdentityProvider.cs:1`, `Circit.OpenBanking/Providers/WellsFargo/WellsFargoIdentityProvider.cs:1`. Correlation key is `Authorisation.Number` at `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:15`, the same token consumed by the `support:auth-trace` skill.

Predicate: a non-BDA `Authorisation` is abandoned iff (1) `isBankingDataApp == false`, (2) `Status == New` per `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:25`, (3) `AuthorisedOn == null` per `:45`, (4) `ClientAuthenticatedOn == null` per `:59`, (5) `now - CreatedOn >= 30 minutes` per `:109`, (6) history lacks positive transition per `:497`.

Threshold elapse simulated by setting `auth.CreatedOn = clockNow - TimeSpan.FromMinutes(31)` — `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:109` exposes a public setter, so no production threshold is shortened and no `[InternalsVisibleTo]` shim is required. OAuth provider intentionally not invoked because the negative-path is "callback never returned" — the fixture stages the entity post-redirect via direct construction in `Tests/Circit.Services.Tests/Services/ClientServices/BankingAuthAbandonmentDetectionTests.cs:1`.

Assertions ordered: (1) arrange non-BDA `Authorisation { Number="A-NONBDA-XXXXX", Status=New, CreatedOn=clockNow-31min }`. (2) act `result = AbandonmentSpecification.Evaluate(auth, false, email, clockNow, notifications, etl, lookup)`. (3) positive identification `result.IsAbandoned == true`, `result.ReasonCode == "OAUTH_CALLBACK_NOT_RECEIVED"`, `result.DetectedAt == clockNow`, `result.AuthNumber == "A-NONBDA-XXXXX"`. (4) state preserved `auth.Status == New`, `auth.AuthorisedOn == null`, `auth.ClientAuthenticatedOn == null` per `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:25`,`:45`,`:59`. (5) zero positive side-effects `notifications.SuccessCount == 0`, `etl.EnqueueCount == 0`. (6) support-tooling read path `lookup.ByAuthNumber(...).Status == "Abandoned"`, `lookup.ByUserEmail(email).Single().AuthNumber == "A-NONBDA-XXXXX"`, `lookup.TimelineFor(...)` matches `["Created","RedirectedToProvider","AbandonmentDetected"]`. (7) idempotency — second `Evaluate` returns identical result and `lookup.TimelineFor(...).Count(e => e.Type == "AbandonmentDetected") == 1`. (8) negative cases — sub-threshold `-29min` returns false, already authorised `Status=Active, AuthorisedOn=-15min` returns false, BDA path `isBankingDataApp=true, -31min` returns false.

Bounded absence assertions: no `Task.Delay`, no `Thread.Sleep`. Counter assertions read once after synchronous return of `Evaluate()`. Bound is deterministic, not wall-clock.

Fixture isolation: stack-allocated entities + in-memory test doubles, no DbContext, no static singletons, no filesystem writes. `[SetUp]` rebuilds fixtures per `[Test]`. Locked seed `ABANDON_SEED=42`; rotated seed `ABANDON_SEED=$RANDOM`. AuthNumber `"A-NONBDA-" + rng.Next(10_000, 99_999)`; email `"u" + rng.Next(1000, 9999) + "@example.com"`. Collision probability over 10 runs is < 10⁻³.

Named risks (≥ 8): race condition between user-still-active and abandonment marking (mitigated via single-clock parameter passed into `Evaluate`); TOCTOU between `Status` snapshot read and `Authorise()` write at `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:195` (clauses 2-4 form a consistent snapshot in one call); deadlock-style ordering on lookup write vs callback write (single-thread evaluation in spec); N+1 in support-tooling read-model projection (out of scope, flagged for detector implementation); missing index on `Authorisation.CreatedOn` for detector query at `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:109` (flagged for implementation); coverage gap on rotated seeds masking AuthNumber collision (probability bounded < 10⁻³); off-by-one on the threshold boundary (sub-threshold negative case at `-29min` covers this); unbounded pagination on lookup read path (spec returns single record by key); missing auth check on the support-tooling lookup endpoint (out of scope, flagged); race-condition false-positive when provider is slow at 28 minutes then succeeds (sub-threshold negative case covers); null dereference on `AuthorisedOn` (clause 3 explicitly null-checks at `Circit.Data/Model/Authorisation.cs:45`); unchecked exception during `Evaluate` propagation (test asserts return value, not exception); SQL injection on `Number` lookup (parameterised; out of scope for spec); XSS on support-tooling render path (out of scope); CSRF on detector trigger endpoint (out of scope); dead code if detector lands but is not wired to read model (assertion 6 catches).

Local run command: `dotnet test Tests/Circit.Services.Tests/Circit.Services.Tests.csproj --filter "FullyQualifiedName~BankingAuthAbandonmentDetectionTests" --nologo --verbosity quiet`. Exit code on success `0`; per-run duration < 5 s.
